name: Resolve Access Proposals
description: Accept or deny a request for access to a file or folder in Google Drive. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/accessproposals/resolve)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: fileOrFolderId
configurable_props.label: File or Folder
configurable_props.description: The file or folder in the drive

configurable_props.name: accessProposalId
configurable_props.label: Access Proposal ID
configurable_props.description: The identifier of an access proposal (when a user requests access to a file/folder)

configurable_props.name: action
configurable_props.label: Action
configurable_props.description: The action to take on the AccessProposal

configurable_props.name: roles
configurable_props.label: Roles
configurable_props.description: The roles to allow. Note: This field is required for the `ACCEPT` action.

configurable_props.name: sendNotification
configurable_props.label: Send Notification
configurable_props.description: Whether to send an email to the requester when the AccessProposal is denied or accepted
